guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「懸浮固體進流」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「沉降速度與池深」的觀測點。用沉降柱畫界面高度與時間，不以單點判定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「表面溢流率」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「有效停留與短流」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「出水堰分配」的觀測點。逐段檢查堰頂高程與出流分布。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「有機物去除與後段」的觀測點。用相同分析方法與流量加權樣本，另列流量差異。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「污泥排出基準」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「尖峰水力情境」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「污泥與上清混合」的觀測點。量兩股流量與成分，再在混合充分的位置採樣。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「固體去向驗證」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent suspended-solids loading. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for settling velocity and depth. Plot settling-column interface height against time rather than using one point. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for surface overflow rate. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective residence and bypass. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effluent-weir distribution. Check weir crest elevation and discharge distribution segment by segment. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for organic removal and downstream demand. Use matching methods and flow-weighted samples and report any flow difference. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge-withdrawal basis. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for peak hydraulic scenario. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sludge and supernatant mixing. Measure both flows and concentrations, then sample after adequate mixing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solids-destination verification. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只看濁度替代固體質量。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
把單一粒子速率當全部污泥行為。診斷與介入：用沉降曲線與有效水深核對，檢查短流及再懸浮。
只加深卻以為表面負荷降低。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。
角落死水與中間高速流並存。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。
長堰未調平仍發生偏流。診斷與介入：對照堰高程與沿堰流量，查局部偏流及附著物。
只追求最大初沉去除而忽略後段需要。診斷與介入：配對進出水流量及分析基準，另外確認轉化產物。
排出體積增加但濃度下降。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
以日均流量判定短時超載。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。
旁流接回入口但未納入採樣。診斷與介入：核對兩股流量及同成分分析，避免以簡單平均混合。
槽內堆積被誤當穩定去除。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
pitfallsEn: Turbidity is used as a substitute for solids mass. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
One-particle velocity is taken as all sludge behavior. Diagnostic response: Check settling curves/effective depth and investigate bypass/resuspension.
Deepening alone is assumed to reduce surface loading. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
Dead corners coexist with a fast central path. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
A long unlevel weir still causes maldistribution. Diagnostic response: Compare weir elevation/local flow and inspect uneven flow/deposits.
Maximizing primary removal ignores downstream needs. Diagnostic response: Match inlet/outlet flow and analysis bases and check transformation products separately.
Withdrawal volume rises while solids concentration falls. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
Daily mean flow is used to judge brief overload. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
Returned sidestreams are excluded from sampling. Diagnostic response: Check both flows and same-species analyses rather than arithmetic averaging.
Accumulation is mistaken for steady removal. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

history.title: 初級沉澱池設計
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以沉降、水力分配與初沉污泥收支為主線，從懸浮固體進流、沉降速度與池深、表面溢流率、有效停留與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops settling, flow distribution and primary-sludge balance through ten connected units, beginning with influent suspended-solids loading, settling velocity and depth, surface overflow rate, effective residence and bypass. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
